q28.

Based on my analysis of the repository, the server starts the following background workers:

**S3 presign runner** — time.Ticker with 12-hour interval

The server (`/bench/repo/server/server.go`) invokes `s3presignRunner.Run()` in its `startBackgroundRunners()` method (lines 153-174). This runner uses a `time.NewTicker(runnerInterval)` where `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` (`/bench/repo/server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, line 27-30).

**Unused scheduling infrastructure:**

The codebase contains a complete scheduler implementation in `/bench/repo/internal/scheduler/scheduler.go` that supports cron-style job scheduling, but it is not used by the server. The `memopayload` runner (`/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) is also present but not started as a background runner—it's only used for on-demand payload rebuilding within request handlers (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`).
